changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingrule AS SELECT br.id, br.name, br.billing_item_type, br.billing_trigger, br.created_by, br.created_date, br.last_modified_by, br.last_modified_date, br.is_default FROM public.billing_rule br;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingrule TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingrule FROM report_user;
